summary: A birth is remembered by its size and by the paper printing it.
realLife: A Minnesota man of eighty-one told of a son recorded as a record-size baby at birth, which the newspapers publicized.
sources: University of Minnesota Morris, Jacob Schmitz interview, about 1977: https://digitalcommons.morris.umn.edu/kmrs/82
inGame: `event:person-birth` with `named`. `needs:` birth weight and length on the birth record, and a paper that prints births (the press desk).

turns.pulledBy: a premature birth on the health record
turns.writesBack: the line says the baby was small and how the family coped
the line gives the name and the day
